subject: world_language
concept: Understanding specialized vocabulary within a chosen professional or academic field in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C1 'specialized vocabulary' descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a specialized field term in the target language to its correct definition
exercise.abstract: Student uses specialized field vocabulary correctly in an original sentence

misconception_flags: uses a specialized term in a context where its meaning doesn't actually apply

interest_binding: field/vocabulary set generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
